name: monitor
description: Monitoring stack management: upgrade the bundled Grafana dashboards.
author: nself
notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port, no HTTP server, and no database tables. `nself plugin install monitor` must place the built nself-monitor binary at ~/.nself/plugins/bin/nself-monitor, where internal/plugin/router.go's ProxyCommand execs it for `nself monitor <args>` with stdio inherited. Extracted from cli/cmd/commands/monitor.go under CLI-R11 (the command had no internal/* package of its own — the dashboard list was inline).
